decision: Metadata inventory only. Protocol, population, byte caps and durable checkpoint policy require root freeze before any payload collection.
inventory_semantics: AWS object discoverability and listed identities only; neither row completeness nor chain receipt completeness established by listing.

measured_prior_acquisitions.cpu_note: Prior manifests measure wall acquisition and RSS, not process CPU seconds.

same_day_multi_address_reuse.existing_cli: repeat --address; complete single address-column scan uses membership in the address union
same_day_multi_address_reuse.restriction: Do not reuse a selected single-emitter JSONL as complete input for another emitter; rescan the complete address column and project all matches for the new frozen union.
same_day_multi_address_reuse.scope: A single Ethereum source day can serve multiple emitters with separate population projections. These two target windows do not overlap in date, so they share no raw daily bytes.

windows.projection_estimate_limit: Extrapolation from two Euler days. Match distribution for remaining days/Beanstalk is unknown until a complete address scan; not a measured coverage claim.
